materials.name: Power-floated concrete
materials.description: Plain industrial slab finish with saw-cut joints. The starting surface of most modern units.

materials.name: Worn concrete
materials.description: Old, stained and patched slab in the older brick buildings. Existing surface only; not sold.

materials.name: Ground and polished concrete
materials.description: Slab ground smooth and sealed; dust-free and easy to sweep.

materials.name: Painted concrete, grey
materials.description: Two coats of floor paint over the existing slab; joints remain visible.

materials.name: Industrial epoxy, grey
materials.description: Self-levelling epoxy coating; nearly seamless and resistant to oil and coolant.

materials.name: Industrial epoxy, green
materials.description: The same coating in a muted green, often used to mark clean assembly areas.

materials.name: Steel floor plate
materials.description: 10 mm plates bolted down over the slab in 1 m × 2 m modules, for heavy wear areas.

materials.name: Diamond tread plate
materials.description: Raised-pattern steel plate in 1 m × 2 m modules for walkways and loading areas.

materials.name: Anti-slip coating
materials.description: Gritted resin coating for wet or oily floors.

materials.name: Yellow safety hatching
materials.description: Painted diagonal yellow and grey hatching for hazard and keep-clear areas.

materials.name: Vinyl floor tile
materials.description: Hard-wearing 300 mm vinyl composition tiles, the usual floor of the commercial units.

materials.name: Carpet tile
materials.description: 500 mm loop-pile carpet tiles for offices.
